The change is commit `c21a7cbf` (PR #6346, "TRUNK-6683: Skip full-text search with drugs when a concept is provided"). It adds `concept == null` to the guard around the ConceptName full-text lookup in `HibernateConceptDAO.newDrugQuery`. When a concept is supplied, the `ConceptName` search no longer runs. The drugs of that concept still match through the `concept.conceptId` clause, and drug-name and code matching are unchanged. The service layer only passes arguments through, so the fix lives entirely in the DAO.

Evidence, best first:

1. The fix itself: the guard is now `searchDrugConceptNames && concept == null`, with a comment explaining the skip (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java:1581-1593`, and the `concept.conceptId` filter at 1601-1603).
2. The commit diff that introduced that one-line change (`openmrs-core`, commit `c21a7cbfa2c9f67c1991372a343217e949e04f44`, hunk at `HibernateConceptDAO.java` line 1577).
3. The pull request that carries the commit: `openmrs-core` PR #6346.
4. New regression tests for both branches: `getDrugs_shouldNotSearchConceptNamesWhenConceptIsSupplied` and `getDrugs_shouldSearchConceptNamesWhenNoConceptIsSupplied` (`openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAOTest.java`, about lines 125-158; I did not re-read these lines, so the exact range is approximate).
5. Test fixture data: concept 20 "ZEBRACONCEPT" with drug "Placebo-X" (`openmrs-core/api/src/test/resources/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/include/HibernateConceptTestDataSet.xml`, about lines 46-49).
6. The unchanged service pass-through, `ConceptServiceImpl.getDrugs(...)` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/ConceptServiceImpl.java:1579-1581`).
7. The public service signature the question refers to (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/ConceptService.java:1686-1687`).
8. The ticket: TRUNK-6683.

Note that this is a behavior change: with a concept supplied, a phrase that matches only a concept name no longer pulls in other concepts' drugs. The new test asserts exactly that.
